title: Accelerate independent schema-v2 field-analysis checker
objective: Make the schema-v2 field-analysis certificate checker plausibly fast for a public boundary while preserving independent exact recomputation and corruption rejection

handoff.summary: Replaced allocation-heavy schema-v2 order/radical/multiplier replay with one ordinary-Python, source-transparent packed GMP proof kernel. The same body is the dynamic fallback; a structurally separate nested-matrix oracle, CPython fixtures, compiled/dynamic six-case differentials, and corruption tests preserve checker independence. The durable benchmark compiles the exact source, measures transfer/check/end-to-end, retains a same-body dynamic control, and compares warmed fresh public maximal_order. On linux-x64, compiled end-to-end medians are 4.17-42.83 ms and are 2.0-4.8x faster than the current public path on all six cases.
risks: The readable proof body adds exactly 26,511 bytes to number-field-algorithms (651,283 total), so the delegated central package-budget increase must land before architecture:check and portable become green.
Focused compiled/dynamic and CPython validation ran on linux-x64; integration should retain the existing cross-platform production-kernel build matrix for arm64, Windows x64, and macOS arm64.
next_steps: Integrate this checkpoint with the central number-field-algorithms budget increase, then rerun architecture:check and portable.

In a separate lane, gate a public fused-result hook strictly on immediately decoded certified=True and preserve unchanged fallback/cache semantics for partial, arbitrary-prime, and native-failure results.
